entries.summary: Creating, renaming, moving, deleting and saving files now shows the result at once and undoes it with an error if the server refuses.

In chat, changing the model, workspace, tools, YOLO, reasoning or personality, editing, clearing or undoing history, starting /background work, and editing or cancelling a steer or queued message now show the result at once.
Approval, question and password prompts leave as soon as you answer and come back with an error if the answer did not reach the server.
The OpenRouter budget and quota thresholds stay editable while they save.
